IMPORTED & MANUAL ACTIVITY

Other Exercise

NEXTFORM / MORE

Explore

Additional tools and account settings.

YOUR FIVE-DAY TRAINING PLAN

Customise this training day

Change exercises, set counts and rep targets. Your five training days remain available. Previously logged workouts are never rewritten.

Saving changes clears unsaved set drafts for this day, after confirmation.

Check each set as you finish it. Enter the weight and repetitions actually performed. Save any number of completed sets when time runs out. You can return and finish the remaining sets later. XP is awarded only for newly saved sets; the session bonus is proportional to completed sets. Rank also requires cumulative reps, kg lifted (weight × reps), and from C Rank upward, bodyweight-relative strength trials. Inactivity lowers current rank after a 7-day grace period (one tier per 14 further days). Regain the first lost tier after 3 distinct active days, then one more tier per 5 additional active days; each tier also requires a workout or cardio day. Attributes lose 5 points per 7 inactive days after the grace period. Lifetime XP and records remain saved.

OPTIONAL ENDURANCE TRAINING

Run · Cycle · Walk · Other Exercise

Log distance activities or other exercise sessions (Yoga, HIIT, Pilates, Weight Training and more). Imported Strava and Oura sessions also appear in your history. Other Exercise contributes bounded XP and consistency, but not running, cycling or lifting milestones without those measurements.

MONTHLY PROGRESSION

Monthly Challenges

ASCENSION PATH

From F to S Rank

Every rank requires XP, training sessions, total repetitions and total training volume (kg × reps). C Rank onward also requires strength trials scaled to bodyweight. Partial sessions count and can be continued without double-counting.

Achievement Badges

Strength Trials · Relative to Bodyweight

Bench, squat, overhead press and Romanian deadlift milestones are scaled to your current bodyweight. Your best estimated 1-rep max (e1RM) is calculated from logged sets of 1–10 reps. These are game milestones, not medical or normative strength standards. Never attempt a max lift just to earn a badge.

YOUR MILESTONES

Achievement Timeline

Achievements are recorded when first reached and remain in your timeline. Milestone badges do not award extra XP.

ATHLETICISM · PERFORMANCE TESTS

Athleticism

35% mobility consistency · 30% plank · 25% push-ups · 10% single-leg balance. Enter your best measured result; incomplete tests count as zero.

Original benchmarks include a 180-second plank, 40 strict push-ups and 60-second balance; the Skill Tree now extends into advanced mastery goals. Push-up targets depend on your selected benchmark category. Mobility consistency reaches its maximum at 20 completed mobility days.

PERFORMANCE RECORDS

Personal Bests

Strength records use estimated 1RM from sets of 1–10 reps. Cardio pace records are based on completed sessions within ±10% of the stated distance.

PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD

Next Session Targets

Recommendations use your last completed session. When every set reaches the top of its prescribed rep range, a small weight increase is suggested. Adjust for technique, recovery and comfort.

YOUR ACCOUNT

Profile & Cloud Sync

Sign in on your phone or desktop to access the same ASCENSION progress. Your cloud save is automatically downloaded when you sign in or reopen the app. Changes automatically upload after saving.

Checking cloud configuration…

Automatic sync is enabled after cloud data is loaded or this device's data is uploaded. Check the status above before switching devices. Export a JSON backup before your first migration.

Your Training Profile

Your baseline is 192 cm and 140 kg. Benchmark category changes performance milestones, not your recorded results, XP per workout, Discipline, or Recovery. Open / Custom retains the existing benchmarks. Height is recorded for your profile; it does not automatically increase strength targets. Bodyweight-adjusted achievements use your latest logged weight, or your starting weight if none is logged.

Your records are saved locally and automatically synced when signed in and online. Export a backup periodically. Sign in above to sync between devices. Export a backup before migrating or resetting data.

Reset permanently removes local records.

Training guidance: start with manageable loads, use controlled technique, and progress gradually. Pelvic floor exercises should involve full relaxation; stop if they cause pain. This app is a training tracker, not medical advice. Privacy Policy · Terms of Service
